title: The 0.31 G6: a custom free stream on unsteady_rotor, confirmed on 26.124
package: feat/0-31 at 8d0c8827 (runs.json package_commit 8d0c8827255cf0b6da298bc0db33c4f020d6340f, package_dirty false); a second post on f64d888c listed the same 22 products and the same skips

files_read.<workspace>: the run's own workspace; its machine path is withheld (NFR-31)
files_read.log: P9321-M144RE438AL+000BE+000_log.txt line 23 in the datapoint folder of sim_9321

field.solver_log_line: Freestream velocity custom profile imported from this location: (9321 log line 23; absent from the 9322 log)
field.velocity: (V, 0, 0) at every point, V the row's free-stream speed

differences.rotor_table: CT, CQ, CP and ETA differ by one unit of the fifth decimal (not equal to every printed digit)

skips_each_point.probes/P9321-M144RE438AL+000BE+000_phase: case '9321' names its rotors, so each reduces over ITS OWN blade passage and there is no single passage of the ROW: the per-rotor files are probes/P9321-M144RE438AL+000BE+000_phase_locked_ROTOR.csv.
skips_each_point.probes/P9321-M144RE438AL+000BE+000_per_b: case '9321' names its rotors, so each reduces over ITS OWN blade passage and there is no single passage of the ROW: the per-rotor files are probes/P9321-M144RE438AL+000BE+000_per_blade_ROTOR.csv.

the plots table holds no column of a blade family of rotor 'ROTOR' (its blades are ['Blade1', 'Blade2', 'Blade3', 'Blade4', 'Blade5', 'Blade6']), so there is no blade to give a row to. A blade's plots are the ones named for its family: declare a plot group with families = "each" or frame = "LOCAL_AXIS" over the rotor in the pproc artifact. It takes a new run; the script defines what the solver plots.

not_written_without_skip: sections/<point>_harmonics.csv (no sections series written for these points)
nondimensional_only: only nondimensional values of the propeller and its run; the rotor speed, free-stream speed, density, time step and every force and moment in N or N m are not published
